title: ConformanceCaseDefinition
description: The NORMATIVE definition of one conformance case in tier-graph-api. It describes WHAT is tested and the expected behavior; it does NOT contain executable payloads. The concrete input/profile-fixture/request/expected payloads live in a separate implementation repository, referenced by `executableFixture`.

operation.description: The primary API operationId under test.

competencyQuestions.description: The competency questions this case exercises.

conformanceClasses.description: The conformance class(es) this case exercises.

ontologicalProperty.description: The ontological property / invariant the case tests (one sentence).

requiredInvariants.description: The invariants an implementation MUST satisfy to pass this case.

expectedBehavior.description: The normative expected behavior, in prose.

fixtureContract.description: The contract that an executable fixture for this case must follow: which files it provides and (optionally) the schema each conforms to.

input.description: Schema/ref an input.json must follow, or a description of it.

profileFixture.description: Schema/ref a profile-fixture.json must follow, or a description of it.

request.description: The request shape (operation parameters or request-body schema).

expected.description: The expected-result shape (response schema for the operation).

executableFixture.description: Pointer to the executable fixture in the implementation repository. This specification repository does NOT contain the payloads.

path.description: Path within that repository to the fixture case directory.

definition.description: Relative path to the case's normative prose document (cases/T0N.md).
